description: This PHP source file defines the HtmlResponse class, which extends Laminas\Diactoros\Response and provides functionality to generate HTML HTTP responses, including setting headers and response body. It includes methods for constructing the response with HTML content, handling streams, and validating input types.

classes.name: Laminas\Diactoros\Response\HtmlResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response containing HTML content, with convenience for setting Content-Type headers and managing the response body stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an HtmlResponse with given HTML content, optional status code, and headers.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from provided HTML input, validating its type and handling stream creation.
